Topic 12.3: Manipulative MOTOR SKILLS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Manipulative MOTOR SKILLS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Perform various manipulative activities for enjoyment
2. Have fun as they practice various manipulative skills
3. Develop awareness of different strength required for kicking different objects 109

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Perform various manipulative activities for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform various manipulative activities for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Have fun as they practice various manipulative skills
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to have fun as they practice various manipulative skills. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Develop awareness of different strength required for kicking different objects 109
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop awareness of different strength required for kicking different objects 109. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Manipulative MOTOR SKILLS.
2. Explain Manipulative MOTOR SKILLS to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: Perform various manipulative activities for enjoyment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Manipulative MOTOR SKILLS. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Manipulative MOTOR SKILLS important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
